name: models-ok
description: AI/ML API GET /v1/models?include=pricing, hand-minimized from a real recording (2026-10-15): 11 of the 932 published rows with their REAL pricing objects, chosen so the family filter and the price projection are both exercised. anthropic/claude-haiku-5-5 appears as BOTH openai/chat-completions and anthropic/messages (one chat model, two rows -> merged by id) and again as anthropic/batches (not chat); openai/gpt-6.1-sol appears as openai/chat-completions and openai/responses/submit (the openai/ prefix is not the discriminator); x-ai/grok-imagine-image-2.0 as openai/image-generations and openai/image-editing, and it is the kind=variants shape whose unit carries price: null. openai/embeddings and internal/* rows must be dropped. One 12th row is SYNTHETIC - synthetic/unpriced-chat-model, with no pricing key at all - because every real row is priced and the unpriced path needs a case. Expect chat 4 ids from 5 rows, image 2 ids from 2 rows.
